model_output:
```sql
WITH park_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM parks
  WHERE id = 245538
),
goldston_region AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Goldston'
    AND border_type = 'city'
    AND addr_state = 'NC'
),
goldston_mean_elevation AS (
  SELECT AVG(ST_Value(r.rast, 1)) AS mean_elevation
  FROM public.dem_us r
  JOIN goldston_region g ON ST_Intersects(r.rast::geometry, g.geometry)
),
park_elevation_stats AS (
  SELECT
    p.geometry,
    AVG(ST_Value(r.rast, 1)) AS avg_elevation
  FROM parks p
  JOIN public.dem_us r ON ST_Intersects(r.rast::geometry, p.geometry)
  WHERE p.id = 245538
)
SELECT
  'Goldston Recreational Park' AS park_name,
  p.avg_elevation,
  g.mean_elevation
FROM park_elevation_stats p, goldston_mean_elevation g
WHERE p.avg_elevation > g.mean_elevation;
```
